test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, D, L, X, Y and Z, are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the left of B. Only four people sit between B and Y. Only three people sit to the right of Z. A sits to the immediate left of L. D is not an immediate neighbour of Z. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, D, L, X, Y and Z, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) No one sits to the left of B.

2) Only four people sit between B and Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42ed737c79c129b25b199c620b6ef030a77803639ca5485fe5fbcd7b84eb7459.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d45ae3c8d243bab5f50d3385826aa1c8fea28442e2d56e5774351bcad058b31.png] 

3) Only three people sit to the right of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31ee1decb2cd51b8def73cf0e9ed659476a0cf1cb58bbb820d41cdb1ec9ea8aa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6a19181f85e7648bf35b11cad1f1a1df3723a3f18834acaf91e38689d33875a.png] 

4) A sits to the immediate left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd2afdc2befce46d348650911d47a07c3fb008bbde124cbc734ccf4e71ab969f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71bd932974c00eae9b9dad380c228a90f3291dd9b0b2f09386428e12f12df8a8.png] 

5) D is not an immediate neighbour of Z.

After positioning D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78da1f0372fe46ec8086b84fc2d9b0bc3311496370914ea43fceb93d8d1500b8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/057db65fe74f984bcb9f902da68a826029b554a956a4b59aa28d700ee57583b5.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D sits at the rightmost end of the line.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
